records.reason: Steps\code owns the shared step algorithm. even_step and odd_step supply local x and next through dynamic binding. Throws declares the exits once; all four copy(Throws) uses are counted. Entry points are Steps\Example\run(0), Steps\Example\run(1), and Steps\Example\run(100001). Exits propagate to the caller; this is not a root Message handler. [Dereference and catch](FAILURE_BOUNDARIES.md#trampoline).

The listing includes the complete Around helper. Trace\code shares event recording and failure checking; Trace\eval owns the journal update. Acquire, Action, and Release declare their own x before invoking the shared code. Release calls eval after int: x 3; a declaration argument is not mistaken for an invocation. Entry is Trace\Example\run(mode). Resource 42, all three callbacks, and results 42123, -123, -1 for modes 0, 1, 2 are preserved.
